_about: Hand-maintained list of platform listings that host other vendors' products inside their own authorization boundary (FedRAMP-as-a-service / GSS platforms). For each host listing ID, every service on its marketplace service list is treated as a hosted third-party product, except services whose names start with one of own_prefix (the platform's own components). Hosted products get their own search result and a card that marks them not established. Add a host here when a listing starts carrying other vendors' products.
